title: Tombstone expiry plus ReplayProtector eviction forgets ACK counter floor
description: python/src/lichen/schc/fragment.py deletes expired tombstones while link/replay.py LRU may evict the peer window. After both, an old captured signed ACK can terminate a new session. Retain/persist per-key floor, pin active/tombstoned replay state or fail closed, and test forced eviction plus hold-down expiry.
